reason: Com2 interventions replace arbitrary event text. The 32-way binary intervention-ID operator used by the closed-value families cannot receive replacement text and is therefore not an executable Com2 operator.
source_checkpoint_policy: freeze the exactly paired validation-selected A1 T2-b BERT-base reader and trained open-text head; ignore its addressed editor

operator_input.representation: the frozen T2-b reader's pooled [address; replacement] instruction
operator_input.o2: ungated rank-16 additive residual from [slot; instruction]

training.records: accepted com2_intervention and com2_counterfactual records plus deterministic factual-restoration exposure at every chain position
training.objective: equal-weight changed-event and preserved-event teacher-forced open-text cross entropy

baselines.prompting: frozen reader and open-text head, full attention over the ordered combined command, addressed editor bypassed
baselines.lora_matched: query/value LoRA only; deterministic rank minimizing distance to the instantiated textual O3 parameter count; same open-text objective

selection: fixed step 500; no validation-driven hyperparameter or checkpoint selection

evaluation.truth: 70 independently double-annotated and adjudicated ordered Com2 pairs
